_readme: WHAT THE SERVED MODEL CAN ACTUALLY RECEIVE. A COMMITTED TABLE, NOT AN INFERENCE.
Keyed by the STEM of paths.model in the profile (e.g. '.../your model.sp-model'
-> 'your model'). harness/senses/capability.py rules from this file and from
nothing else: a model that is not listed here has NO senses, full stop. That is
deliberate and it is the whole point of the file.
WHY THIS EXISTS. On 2026-07-31 the audio path was found injecting 3840-wide frames
into a 2816-wide model. var/voice/embed_audio.npz was extracted from gemma4-12b
(E=3840); the served your model has E=2816 and its config.json carries
audio_config: null - it has no audio embedder at all. Neither side checked:
native.py never compared E, and routes.rs only verified the frames were
self-consistent ('each must be E floats' - but E was taken from frames[0].len()).
A model swap silently moved the hidden dim and the sense kept its old weights.
'e' MUST match the served model's hidden size. Every encoder asserts against it
before returning a single frame, and an encoder whose projection disagrees
refuses rather than injects. Fail closed: no sense is better than a false one.
Token ids are from the model's own config.json, never guessed.

your model.audio_absent_reason: config.json audio_config is null and the GGUF ships no audio tensors; mmproj-BF16.gguf is 355 v.* + 1 mm.*, vision only. This model cannot hear. Verified 2026-07-31.
